name: Hlk Fm22X → On Face Scan Matched
description:
An action to be performed when an enrolled face is scanned and recognized. See [`on_face_scan_matched`](https://esphome.io/components/hlk_fm22x/#on_face_scan_matched-trigger).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever a face scan is matched to an enrolled face. To use the variables, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates) template, the matched face id is available inside that lambda under the variable named `face_id` and the face name under the variable named `name`.
